mysqld.WhatItDoes: Serves SQL databases; RAM scales with buffer pool and connections
mysqld.BusinessHint: Keep if local apps (WordPress, dev stack) need DB; stop service when not developing
SuggestedActions: Confirm which app uses the DB
Stop MySQL Windows service when unused

vmware-vmx.WhatItIs: Host process for a VMware Workstation/Fusion virtual machine
vmware-vmx.WhatItDoes: Allocates guest RAM and CPU; high Working Set reflects VM memory reservation, not leak
vmware-vmx.BusinessHint: Stop or suspend VM when not needed for work; keep if dev/test environment is active
SuggestedActions: Reduce VM RAM allocation in VM settings
Do not terminate while guest has unsaved work

charon-svc.WhatItIs: StrongSwan IKE/IPsec VPN daemon (charon service wrapper on Windows)
charon-svc.WhatItDoes: Maintains VPN tunnels; loopback traffic to companion process is normal
charon-svc.BusinessHint: Keep if corporate VPN requires StrongSwan; classify as business-critical after operator confirm
SuggestedActions: Add to catalog as Keep if mandatory for work
Operator manual identification — review catalog merge separately

mkssandbox.WhatItIs: VMware VMX sandbox helper (isolated GUI/input for guest)
mkssandbox.WhatItDoes: Supports VMware guest display and input isolation
mkssandbox.BusinessHint: Child of VMware stack — classify with vmware-vmx
SuggestedActions: Treat as part of VMware VM lifecycle
Stops when VM is powered off
